description: This file implements a PHP class 'MagpieRSS' which provides parsing of RSS and Atom feeds, supporting multiple RSS versions and Atom formats. It includes methods for initializing an XML parser, handling parsing events, normalizing feed data, and utility functions for encoding detection and error handling.

classes.name: MagpieRSS
classes.description: A PHP class that parses RSS and Atom feeds into a simple object, supporting multiple versions and encoding detection.

methods.name: MagpieRSS
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with source feed data.

methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, setting context accordingly.

methods.name: feed_cdata
methods.description: Handles character data inside XML elements.

methods.name: feed_end_element
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizing data collection.

methods.name: append_content
methods.description: Appends text content to the current feed or item.

methods.name: append

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes parsed data, converting between RSS and Atom conventions.

methods.name: is_rss
methods.description: Returns the RSS version if feed is RSS, else false.

methods.name: is_atom
methods.description: Returns the Atom version if feed is Atom, else false.
